title: Dear Mr. Potter: Letters of Love, Loss and Magic

values.description:
Dear Mr. Potter: Letters of Love, Loss, and Magic features hundreds of letters and pictures from Harry Potter fans. Individually, these letters and pictures tell stories of how fans have been impacted and inspired by Harry Potter. Together they serve as proof of what all Potter fans know so well: the Harry Potter series changes lives.

Along with fans from around the world, Dear Mr. Potter also features letters from Harry Potter actress Evanna Lynch (Luna Lovegood), New York Times-bestselling author John Green, Leaky Cauldron webmistress and author of New York Times-bestseller Harry, A History Melissa Anelli, Andrew Slack of the Harry Potter Alliance, Paul DeGeorge of Harry and the Potters, Andrew Sims and Eric Scull of MuggleNet, and Esther Earl’s mom, Lori.

notes: Description from the Goodreads record for this ISBN (the only blurb found; it reads as the book's own blurb; italics dropped). Pages not found with confidence: only Goodreads gives one (223); Amazon UK has none.

title: The Callista Prophecy

values.description:
A perilous mission, a world on the edge, a prophecy whispered in the stars.

With the two interstellar civilisations on a collision course, rumours spread of a mysterious phenomenon that is spiriting humans away from border-world slavery. But what, or who, is the Shining Trail?

Three years after the turbulent events that made her famous, Kali still has formidable enemies. Decca’s ruler is convinced that Kali is encouraging the liberation raids, and when she is asked to lead a diplomatic mission to find the truth, the Overlord seizes the chance to destroy her.

But destiny has a voice. The prophecy of a forgotten people will send Kali to a world of dust and deceit, and what she discovers there will shake the foundations of her life. With her expedition crumbling, and enemies circling, can Kali unravel the enigma of the Shining Trail and find a way home?

Recommended for fans of character driven socio-political sci-fi in the style of Ann Leckie and Adrian Tchaikovsky, this is a story of resilience, justice, and the tenacity of the human spirit.

Content note: Best enjoyed after reading Book 1 and Book 2. Features occasional strong language. Suited for adult and advanced crossover readers.

notes: Amazon UK blurb, word for word. Cut only the opening Kirkus Reviews quote. The 'Recommended for fans' and 'Content note' paragraphs are part of the blurb and kept; she may prefer to drop them.

title: The Chronowick Paradox

values.description:
Time is Complex, But so is Reality

Harton Evermore is a Professor of Science at Gildmere University in Chronowick City’s most elegant district. He is also an inventor, alongside his famous father, Mathias Evermore. Behind closed doors, they are working on an illegal invention that would change the fate of a loved one they had lost. One that could alter their timeline.

On the evening of the presentation for inventors, a woman called Heidi O’Nell from the dirtier, poorer district of Copperweld breaks into Harton’s office and finds the notes relating to his invention. She blackmails him into inventing the machine for her so that she may travel back in time and kill the president of Chronowick, Nathaniel Thaddeus, in the hopes of restoring balance and equality within Chronowick’s five districts.

To get on her good side, Harton offers Heidi and her younger sister refuge and a life up in the pristine district of Gildmere whilst teaching her the science needed for their device in exchange for her assistance in constructing it, without his father knowing. He also warns her of the unknown dangers of time paradoxes. But will he help her achieve her goal to save Chronowick from its unfair societal split, or will he betray her and prevent a time paradox from taking place?

notes: Amazon UK blurb, word for word (Bookvault, 11 Jul 2026, 331 pages).

title: Lycan Lamia

values.description: Dawn rises over Danestone Glen following the battle between Christos and his vamp army. Galleano and his rag tag bunch of supers consisting of; werewolf packs from the five continents of The Beyond, a circle of four elemental demons who despise one another, and the Daryavaush paranormal team. Casualties are high and the groups have split and retreated. The four castles of Avalonia seem to have crumbled and the Romanov children are missing. Daryavaush has another nasty shock waiting for them back at the Carmichael Mansion just as a stranger arrives to offer them salvation and protection from the vengeful rogue vampire-witch Kasha. Galleano is at a loss, now doubting his own decisions from centuries ago to present day, he needs to find a cure for Amethyst's sudden 'illness'. Nathaniel and his five packs have suffered the worst losses in centuries and they want revenge. Can the Daryavaush trust their new saviour and find the children of Avalonia before it's too late? Will Galleano save Amethyst's soul and finally find the answers he's so desperately searched for over half a millennia and across the world? Here and now he faces his darkest hour of enlightenment before his own destruction from the Lycan Lamia.

notes: Blackwell's 'Publisher's Synopsis', word for word (one paragraph there).

title: Lemurian Dimensions

values.description:
The thrilling fifth and final book in The Beyond Series of urban fantasy books that will forever change the way you think about Ancient Astronaut Theories, South American Mythology and the reason why Supernatural creatures were ever created.

From the author of Lycan Lamia, Didikai Witch, Vampire Sorceress and Demon Lupus.

What will happen to humans when the Atlanteans invade Earth? Will Elchusian help save the world or will the Scarce Six finally do what they were genetically engineered for?

Stephen is a genius! The cleverest person Louisa has ever met, and she should know, as his wife, Stephen has trusted her with his biggest and most brilliant secret invention ever…. A dimension-jumping, timeslip machine. Their lives take a dramatic turn when armed guards raid their home. In a desperate attempt to save Louisa, Stephen thrusts her into the device sending her hurtling to another dimension.

The Daryavaush, a powerful paranormal investigation team of humans and ‘Supers’—including Witches, Vampires, (Were-Beasts and Shapeshifters), Elemental Demons, a Ghost, and a Hybrid Alien-Human return to save the paranormal world from destruction. Among them is Kate, who can manipulate time and space with her crystal skulls.

Stephen instructs Louisa to contact Kate for help, leaving Louisa with many unsettling Did Stephen choose Louisa to be his wife because of her potential inherited abilities? Is Louisa also a Lemurian Dimension Jumper? Who are the Lemurians?

notes: Goodreads record for this ISBN (the author's blurb). Cut only two reader quotes and the 'Nominee for the Writing Global Excellence Award 2025' line. The original really reads 'many unsettling Did Stephen' (a word is missing); left as printed.

title: Vampire Sorceress

values.description: Michael and Amethyst Romanov are taking a whistle stop tour of Europe. Not for the breath-taking scenery or to sample fine wine and local dishes. Every museum and library is searched and scoured with a fine tooth comb in every country, searching for the true Drukkerebema. The Romany Gypsy prophesies of the Avalonian witches and the birth of their most powerful member has been missing for centuries. The search takes them to Rasnov, a small Citadel high in the Carpathian Mountains of Transylvania. They find some very distant and odd relatives who have many tales of Avalonia across the seas, tales that have been passed from mother to daughter for centuries. Michael is also concerned for Amethysts safety as Avalonia is under attack once more and Amethyst's intuition of them being followed by a reluctant force is soon confirmed. She misses home, but her inquisitive side soon wins the battle and she must decide where her loyalties lie; either in this life or the next death, it matters not to a Vampire Sorceress.

notes: Goodreads record for this ISBN (CompletelyNovel, 4 Sep 2014, 384 pages); Amazon UK and Blackwell's show no blurb. Word for word, typos included ('Amethysts safety').

title: Record of a Spaceborn Few

values.description:
From the ground, we stand. From our ship, we live. By the stars, we hope.

The incredible new novel by Becky Chambers, author of the beloved The Long Way to a Small, Angry Planet.

Centuries after the last humans left Earth, the Exodus Fleet is a living relic, a place many are from but few outsiders have seen. Humanity has finally been accepted into the galactic community, but while this has opened doors for many, those who have not yet left for alien cities fear that their carefully cultivated way of life is under threat.

Tessa chose to stay home when her brother Ashby left for the stars, but has to question that decision when her position in the Fleet is threatened.

Kip, a reluctant young apprentice, itches for change but doesn’t know where to find it.

Sawyer, a lost and lonely newcomer, is just looking for a place to belong.

And when a disaster rocks this already fragile community, those Exodans who still call the Fleet their home can no longer avoid the inescapable question:

What is the purpose of a ship that has reached its destination?

notes: Hachette UK (publisher) page, word for word. Cut only the '*THE SUNDAY TIMES BESTSELLER AND HUGO AWARD WINNER FOR BEST SERIES*' banner and the PRAISE quotes at the end. Kept the publisher's own 'The incredible new novel by' line.

title: A Closed and Common Orbit

values.description:
A warm, comforting, big-hearted stand-alone set in the same world as the award-winning The Long way to Small Angry Planet.

Lovelace was once merely a ship’s artificial intelligence. When she wakes up in an new body, following a total system shut-down and reboot, she has to start over in a synthetic body, in a world where her kind are illegal. She’s never felt so alone.

But she’s not alone, not really. Pepper, one of the engineers who risked life and limb to reinstall Lovelace, is determined to help her adjust to her new world. Because Pepper knows a thing or two about starting over.

Together, Pepper and Lovey will discover that, huge as the galaxy may be, it’s anything but empty.

notes: Hachette UK (publisher) page, word for word, typos included ('an new body', 'The Long way to Small Angry Planet'). Cut only the Daily Mail/Heat/Guardian quotes at the top and the 'READERS LOVE BECKY CHAMBERS' star quotes at the end.

title: Guardian Quest

values.description:
The Quests continue…
After the devastating battles of the Sea Dimension, the Protectors are focused on ensuring those most affected by the tragedy of their exile are safe and healing. Yet Evil continues to harass and endanger their lives both in the Land and World. The Land is beset by a serial killer preying on the populace, and does not possess the skills or mindset to capture such a beast. When another Worlder is tapped to join the fight, the Protectors must overcome their fears to ensure the newest member of their group is fully equipped for the endeavor. The newest recruit has a unique-and perhaps dangerous-link to their past that could unravel their cover in the World Dimension.
The 13th in the Quest Series, Guardian Quest continues the saga of the Land Dimension, fighting Evil in its purest form, and the Worlders who assist in the battle.

notes: Quest #13. Description is the author's blurb on the Goodreads (Kindle) record, word for word. Only the Kindle edition is listed (self-published, 14 Feb 2016, 292 pages), so pages, publisher and date of her print copy aren't known.

title: Rebellion Quest

values.description:
The Quests Continue!

Janet Noxx, an event planner in upstate New York, is thrilled when superstar Zach Neol chooses her company for his upcoming wedding. Little does she know that her involvement in the celebration will lead to a life-changing adventure. After accidently traveling to the Land, Janet finds herself in the middle of a counterpart dilemma which makes her question relationships back in the World Dimension. Thrust into the middle of the wizarding power struggle erupting throughout the Land, Janet also discovers Void personnel are scrutinizing the Protector interaction in the dimension. With each interaction and intersection between the Dimensions Janet must question her abilities and constantly evaluate her place in the Interdimensional arena.

The clash between multiple Dimensions culminates in an epic battle between Good & Evil. The outcome of the conflict will ultimately determine the fate of the Protectors and their futures.

notes: Quest #11. Description is the author's blurb on the Goodreads (Kindle) record, word for word ('accidently' as in the original). Only the Kindle edition is listed (NBTR, 21 Jul 2012, 261 pages), so print pages, publisher and date aren't known.
